facts.fact: Ghana's communications and digital ministry announced on 25 September 2025 nationwide validation workshops on the Draft Innovation and Start-Up Bill, with input from agencies, academia, tech hubs, private sector actors and civil society, which are described as ongoing.

facts.fact: Ghana's communications and digital ministry says the Draft Innovation and Start-Up Bill, covering tax relief, funding access and a certified startup label, is in nationwide validation workshops as of 25 September 2025.
